explanation: With the selected nonnegative matter, radiation and curvature terms and no dark energy, the expansion persists with a declining Hubble rate.
warnings: Massive neutrinos are pressureless over this future-only integration. Ωr is an independently specified photons + effective massless-neutrino density. Tcmb and Neff do not silently recompute Ωr.
Stellar populations and remnant eras are phenomenological proxies; no N-body dynamics, stellar population synthesis, or exact entropy budget is computed.

metadata.solver: Dormand–Prince 5(4); log-scale-factor expansion; regular time-domain contraction; matched constant-fluid asymptotes
metadata.timeOrigin: Elapsed proper years from a(t₀)=1, not total age since the Big Bang
equations: H²/H₀² = (Ωb + Ων,massive) a⁻³ + ρdm/ρc,0 + ρr/ρc,0 + ρde/ρc,0 + Ωk a⁻²
dρi/dt + 3H(1 + wi)ρi = Qi; ΣQi = 0 for conservative transfers
d ln|ρde| / d ln a = −3[1 + w(a)]
dD/d ln a = −3wDM D − ΓD/H − ξD − A D² a⁻³/(H/H₀)
dR/d ln a = a[ΓD/H + ξD + A D² a⁻³/(H/H₀)]
